text.p: ABN AMRO Rothschild said on Friday the banking syndicate backing the flotation of Endemol Entertainment Holding NV had exercised its over-allotment option on an additional 1,453,320 shares.
This increases the number of shares floated on the Amsterdam bourse to 11,142,120. The shares started trading on November 1.

ABN AMRO Rothschild said the additional shares of the "green shoe option" were sold by Endemol's existing shareholders and would therefore not dilute share capital. All shares have already been allocated on November 1, it added in a statement.
Endemol shares were issued one week ago at a price of 48.00 guilders but ABN AMRO Rothschild, which was global coordinator for the public offering, said the issue was 25 times over-subscribed.
On November 1 the shares started trading in Amsterdam at 55.80 guilders and have gained further in the following week. On Friday the stock opened at 59.90 guilders, up 70 cents.
